build_azure_ai_url: build a complete API URL for Azure AI Studio chat completions with api_version query parameter
validate_azure_ai_headers: validate environment headers for Azure AI Studio authentication with api-key or Bearer token
transform_azure_ai_messages: transform Azure AI Studio chat messages by converting list content to strings while preserving images and audio
get_azure_ai_supported_params: get list of supported OpenAI parameters for an Azure AI model filtering tool_choice and stop
retry_azure_ai_on_error: retry Azure AI LLM API call on HTTP errors by dropping unsupported parameters from the request
